label: October 31 prospective public-observation cohort

house.question: Will Democrats win at least 218 of the 435 House seats in the 2026 election?
house.resolution: Certified seat outcomes under the existing challenge rules. Do not substitute popular-vote share, a seat mean, or a median for the probability.

senate.question: Will the Democratic caucus reach at least 51 of 100 Senate seats?
senate.resolution: Certified caucus-aligned seat outcomes under the original challenge rules. Candidate-level independent alignment must match before admission.

historicalStrictCohort.note: This new observation cohort neither backdates the original locks nor retroactively admits old unmatched snapshots.

kahrelumReference.note: Fresh public observation of an existing computed edition; it does not replace the original 91 percent House lock. Source editions and subjective model assumptions remain unchanged.

admissionRules: The public source must provide a numerical chamber-control probability, not a vote share or a seat summary.
Capture must occur within this declared window and before the election cutoff. Preserve the source edition and all known input ages.
The binary event must match the chamber threshold and caucus treatment. Unknown or different independent policies remain excluded.
Conflicting current marginal probabilities fail closed. Rounded categories are not summed or renormalized into a replacement marginal.
The factual source receipts and manifest must be anchored in a verified public commit before records become prospectively admitted.
A common retrieval window is not a common underlying information cutoff. This cohort supports qualified prospective scoring, not a matched-input superiority claim.
Mean, median, favored-seat count and other seat statistics remain distinct; no seat-error comparison is admitted by this probability-only process.
Outcomes remain unresolved until the documented certification rules are satisfied; admission alone produces no Brier score or winner.
limitations: The public receipts preserve facts, short exact evidence, capture intervals and hashes of tool-returned representations. They do not claim exact HTTP-wire custody or independent source-time attestation.
Capture times are bounded by the session clock tool. Publisher timestamps can have lower precision and are not replaced by retrieval times.
The current roster contains 14 numerical external providers. Historical qualitative or unresolved names are not silently reintroduced into the scoring denominator.

notes: The explicit marginal is used. Whole-percent joint-category figures need not reproduce the rounded marginal when added. No joint-category-derived marginal is substituted.
